title: StegVerse NODE_LEDGER_OPENED anchor v1 (issued)
description: The anchor of an EPHEMERAL node ledger, issued by the organization ledger, in the shape StegVerse-Labs/continuity-vault-kit#258 consumes. issuer_receipt_ref is the org ledger's own INTR_MESH_PATH_INGRESS (ORGANIZATION_INTR_DESTINATION_INGRESS) receipt that carried StegOS's generation-time record (node-ledger-opened-generation.v1.json). receipt_sha256 is sha256 over the canonical JSON (sort_keys, separators , :, ensure_ascii false) of every other field. Producer and ORGANIZATION_LEDGER verifier: StegVerse-org/LLM-adapter llm_adapter.endpoint_ledger_anchor.issued_anchor / verify_node_ledger_opened_anchor. TV/TVC is in the issuer enum but no TV/TVC verifier exists (TVC receipts unsigned: TVC#537, LC-KV-08), so a TV/TVC anchor is refused.

node_identity_key.description: Public-key reference only (StegVerse-Labs/StegOS#426 node_identity_key; checked by node_receipt_common.node_identity_key_failure). Never key material.
